notes: Standard configuration (PS-LT and PS-360-EMPX NOT fitted). 3-stage flow cryostat: 'Type: 3-stage flow cryostat (sample + 2 radiation shields)'; 'Partial inner radiation shield; second radiation shield with top viewport surrounds sample'. Cooling via 'Large bore helium/nitrogen transfer line with flow control 12.7 mm (0.5 in) top port withdrawal'. Chamber: 'Chamber access: 133.4 mm (5.25 in) × 243.2 mm (9.58 in) opening'; radiation shield 'Sample access: 59 mm (2.3 in) × 157 mm (6.2 in)'; shield viewport '50 mm (1.97 in) diameter IR absorbing window' under the 63.5 mm quartz chamber viewport. Probes: 'the EMPX-H2 probes are configured at 30° angles for probing wafers up to 25 mm (1 in) in diameter' (overview page https://www.lakeshore.com/products/categories/overview/material-characterization-products/cryogenic-probe-stations/model-empx-h2-cryogenic-probe-station). Field horizontal, parallel to sample plane; homogeneity '0.6% over 10 mm diameter; 2.6% over 25 mm diameter'. Vacuum <1e-5 Torr at He base; ports NW40 pump, NW25 gauge, 0.25 in NPT gas. Cycle: 0.5 h pump, 1.25 h cooldown, 1.25 h warmup. Vibration <300 nm. cryogen set to lhe_flow; LN2 flow is the alternative mode through the same transfer line (catalog cryogen.type lists both). Probe electrical types (DC/RF, microwave to 67 GHz, fiber optic) are per-order, so no fixed coax/DC/fibre count is published.
